description: This file defines the Renderer11 class for the ANGLE project, implementing a D3D11 renderer backend with device capabilities, resource management, and rendering operations.

classes.name: Renderer11
classes.description: A class implementing the D3D11 renderer backend for ANGLE, managing device initialization, resource allocation, rendering, and device capabilities.

classes.name: Renderer11DeviceCaps
classes.description: Structure holding the capabilities of the D3D11 renderer device, such as support for DXGI 1.2, clear view, constant buffer offsets, and driver version.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the D3D11 renderer device and resources.

methods.name: resetDevice
methods.description: Resets the D3D11 device, typically after device loss.

methods.name: getDeviceContext
methods.description: Returns the device context for rendering commands.

methods.name: getRendererDescription
methods.description: Returns a string describing the renderer.

methods.name: copyImage2D
methods.description: Copies a 2D image from framebuffer to texture.

methods.name: createRenderTarget
methods.description: Creates a render target with specified parameters.

methods.name: getMaxSupportedESVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported OpenGL ES version.
